mapper.update: UPDATE ranking_item SET agree_count = GREATEST(agree_count + #{dAgree}, 0), oppose_count = GREATEST(oppose_count + #{dOppose}, 0), participant_count = GREATEST(participant_count + #{dParticipant}, 0), agree_rate = CASE WHEN participant_count + #{dParticipant} > 0 THEN LEAST(GREATEST((agree_count + #{dAgree}) / (participant_count + #{dParticipant}), 0), 1) ELSE 0 END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{itemId}
mapper.select:
SELECT i.id AS itemId, i.name AS name, i.description AS description, i.image_url AS imageUrl, i.source_name AS sourceName, i.creator_id AS creatorId, r.id AS rankingId, r.title AS rankingTitle, r.cover_url AS coverUrl, u.nickname AS creatorNickname FROM ranking_item i JOIN ranking r ON r.id = i.ranking_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.creator_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE i.status = 1 AND r.status = 1 AND r.visibility = 1
AND (i.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.source_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND i.source_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sourceName}, '%')
ORDER BY i.id DESC
